items.title: Dick Spottswood interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 13, 2023
items.q: For instance Mamie Smith, first “Crazy Blues,” that’s okay the first blues recording.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah, precisely. That’s a much better word.

Well I’m currently reading a couple of books and one is by Francis Davis, it’s about the blues and I’m reading things that — this happens fairly often — where you think that you know some facts about music that are true. For instance Mamie Smith, first “Crazy Blues,” that’s okay the first blues recording. And then you read someone who writes —
Well even that’s arguable, isn’t it?
